test_title: PYST 32: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 18 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: A cube of side 5 cm and a cuboid of measurements 35 cm,15 cm and 15 cm, respectively, of the same metal are melted and made into cubes of side 10 cm each. The number of cubes of side 10 cm thus formed is:
solution:
**Given:**

Side of cube 1 = 5 cm

Dimensions of cuboid = 35 cm × 15 cm × 15 cm

Side of cube 2 = 10 cm

**Formula used:**

Volume of cube = Side³

Volume of cuboid = Length × Breadth × Height

Number of cubes = Total volume / Volume of one cube

**Calculations:**

Volume of cube 1 = 5³

⇒ Volume of cube 1 = 125 cm³

Volume of cuboid = 35 × 15 × 15

⇒ Volume of cuboid = 7875 cm³

Total volume = Volume of cube 1 + Volume of cuboid

⇒ Total volume = 125 + 7875

⇒ Total volume = 8000 cm³

Volume of one cube (side 10 cm) = 10³

⇒ Volume of one cube = 1000 cm³

Number of cubes = Total volume / Volume of one cube

⇒ Number of cubes = 8000 / 1000

⇒ Number of cubes = 8

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**
